summary: A small slate: two WTA Beijing quarterfinals, Thursday Night Football and a C-USA college game make up the kept legs, with Swiatek, Andreeva and the Cowboys trimmed toward bookmaker prices. Excluded legs are Challenger and WTA 125 tennis and a non-tier-1 Valorant qualifier.

verdicts.reason: Fixture confirmed (Liberty home, Thu 8 Oct 23:00 UTC, C-USA); Liberty 4-1 vs winless-in-FBS Sam Houston 1-3, no QB injury news (WSET, A Sea of Red); Dimers model 84.5% and consensus ML -520/-590 (~82-84%) match market; spread steady at -13.5 since 4 Oct (WagerTalk); clear weather (NWS).
verdicts.main_risk: Sam Houston's C-USA-leading pass attack keeps it close, as in both previous meetings decided by 2-5 points.

verdicts.reason: Week 5 TNF, Bucs (0-4) at Cowboys (2-2) in Arlington; Mayfield out (thumb) so undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts (Bowles via tampabay28), Winfield, Morrison, Dennis out (CBS/AP); but the line has drifted from -10 to -8.5 on sharp Tampa money (VSiN, SI) and DraftKings -455/+350 de-vigs to ~78.7%, below the 80.5% market.
verdicts.main_risk: Mobile QB Daniels extends plays against Dallas's weak pass rush (4 sacks, no INTs) and Tampa keep it close in a one-score finish.

verdicts.reason: Beijing QF confirmed on the official draw; Swiatek leads Mertens 2-0 and beat Jovic 6-1 6-3, but Mertens just beat Gauff 6-3 6-3 (AFP/Yahoo); book average 1.21/4.37 de-vigs to ~0.783 and String Tension Elo 64%, both below market.
verdicts.main_risk: Swiatek starts slowly again (lost the first set to Vekic) and an in-form Mertens out-rallies her.

verdicts.reason: Official OP: Diamond Court, not before 11:00 UTC today; Alexandrova leads H2H 2-0 in straight sets and just beat No. 5 seed Noskova 6-2 6-2; book average 3.58/1.29 de-vigs to ~0.735 and String Tension Elo 62.6%, below market.
verdicts.main_risk: Alexandrova's flat first-strike hitting rushes Andreeva again, as in both previous meetings.
